item.title: Columbus.gov Monthly Audit
item.description:
Columbus.gov Monthly Audit

Greetings!

As part of our ongoing maintenance of the content on Columbus.gov, each editor is required to perform a review of their content MONTHLY. This review should help to ensure content is fresh, links are working, old content is removed, pages are ADA compliant, and content is presented and structured following best practices. As a reminder, we are copying a few pages from our Governance doc that focus on maintenance (pages 14, 28-32 of the Governance doc). More on content best practices can be found starting on page 35 of the Governance doc.

As a reminder, all web pages and files attached to web pages need to be ADA compliant.  THIS INCLUDES EVERY PDF, DOCUMENT, and DIGITAL ASSET THAT YOU HAVE ATTACHED TO THE WEB PAGE!  Please refer to this site for information on how to convert your digital assets Create Accessible Digital Products | Section508.gov. 

You can use tools such as Page Speed Insights to scan your pages individually.

OpenCities has a built in Accessibility Checker that you can run at any time from the editing environment. It also runs when you publish. When you publish a page, you may get a “Content Report” warning with an “Accessibility” subtitle that your page includes issues.  Please correct any warnings or errors identified as soon as possible. You will not be able to publish until you correct all accessibility errors.  If you are unsure how to correct, please submit a Tech Desk ticket.  

 

These checks highlight opportunities to improve the accessibility of your web app. Automatic detection can only detect a subset of issues and does not guarantee the accessibility of your web app, so manual testing is also encouraged.

We encourage you to attend our next User Group Meeting Wednesday Jan 7 12-1pm.

If you have any questions or concerns prior to the next Monthly Audit, please submit a ticket to Tech Desk.

item.title: Columbus.gov Monthly Audit
item.description:
Columbus.gov Monthly Audit

For OpenCities Editors, Content Creators and Owners

Greetings!

It’s time for Monthly Audits!  As you are performing these, please be mindful of the items below considering whether content is relevant, include calls to action, and match the city voice and tone, etc.  One additional point of concern for these audits is finding and correcting any “Page Not Found” errors. 
 
A good audit includes going through all your pages and all your links to ensure everything is still functioning, as expected. 

For more information, please visit the CBUS/Website Redesign Resource Page. From this page you will find the following:

  • The Granicus/OpenCities Broken Links Report
  • The Latest Google Analytics Report
  • Governance Documents 

Please join us for Office Hours/User Group Meeting every 2nd & 4th Tuesday of the month at 10am.

Office Hours/User Group Meetings are an opportunity for you to ask questions, get assistance on a process or edit, or just learn from each other.  Oftentimes, we also have items we like to call to your attention or training on functions that seem to be creating confusion. 

If you are not attending, you are likely missing out!  Hope to see you there!

If you have any questions or concerns prior to the next meeting, please submit a ticket to TechDesk.
